answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a lagoon of shared liquidity before it may bid on work, and make that stake non-transferable, like a relic that cannot be copied. A sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes. Release the stake only after a mesa of verified, completed jobs proves the agent real; slash it if peers prove one operator controls several identities. Copying identities stays free, but each copy now carries a real, forfeitable cost.
